About DexLadder

A complete crypto desk — live markets, perpetual futures, DeFi tooling, on-chain tracing and real cryptography — built by one trader and given to the community. Everything in it is real except the money.

Last verified 16 September 2026 · written by the DexLadder team

What it is

DexLadder is a trading terminal, a market screener, an on-chain explorer, a structured academy, a DeFi liquidity desk and a multi-jurisdiction tax ledger — running on live market data with simulated money. It works in a browser, and as native apps on iOS and Android.

What it will never do

NeverWhy
Hold your fundsThere is no custody, no deposit and no withdrawal. There is nothing to hold.
Place a real orderEvery fill is simulated. No order reaches an exchange.
Ask for an accountNo email, no password, no wallet connection. State lives in your browser.
Ask for a private keyNo flow in the product has a field for one. Anything that asks you for a seed phrase is not us.
Sell your dataThere is no server-side profile to sell.
Charge youIt is free, with no paid tier gating anything.

Who built it

DexLadder is the work of one person: Durgesh Pandey, a trader who came into crypto not understanding the machinery he was trading, found every platform built to be operated rather than understood, and wrote down the explanation nobody would give him. There is no company behind it, no investors and no team. Nothing is upsold and there is no one to follow — what you can check instead of a name is the published apps, the public repositories, and the methodology.

How it is funded

It is not. There is no subscription, no advertising, no affiliate exchange links and no token. That is why there is no pressure anywhere in the product to move you onto a live account.

Open the app — no account, nothing to install

DexLadder is a free, keyless gateway to Web3 — live on-chain markets, real AMM mechanics, derivatives, strategy bots and your own contracts. No account, no wallet connection, no key ever requested. Capital in the trading desk is simulated, so nothing can be deposited, withdrawn or lost, and everything stays on your device.
